hub.headline: SGL and SBL were Sega's graphics and system libraries for developing Sega Saturn games.
hub.next: Find and verify primary documentation for SGL and SBL.
hub.what_it_was: SGL and SBL were libraries for programming the Sega Saturn, a console with two SH-2 processors and the VDP1, VDP2 and SCU chips. The archive has not yet confirmed further detail from a primary source.
hub.what_survives: No authorized source release is known, and rights are unresolved. The archive has not yet located a verified primary source for this entry.

name: Sega Saturn SGL / SBL
summary: Sega graphics/system libraries for dual-SH2 Saturn development; documentation-only lead, no known authorized source release.
